record.context_brief: Bienergy-critical identity maps on statistical manifolds
record.original_question: For a statistical manifold, when is the identity map a critical point of the bienergy functional for maps from (M, g, nabla) to (M, g, nabla^*)?

evidence.quote: For a smooth map ψ : (M, g, ∇) → (M, g, ∇∗), its bienergy over a relatively compact region D of M is E2(ψ; D) = Z D 1/2 ||τ(ψ)||2 dvg. Based on these observations, we propose here • Investigate statistical manifolds whose identity map is a critical point of the bienergy functional.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,g)$ be a smooth Riemannian manifold and let $
abla$ be a torsion-free affine connection on $M$ such that the cubic tensor $C(X,Y,Z)=(
abla_X g)(Y,Z)$ is totally symmetric in $X,Y,Z$; the triple $(M,g,
abla)$ is then called a statistical manifold. The dual (conjugate) connection $
abla^*$ of $
abla$ with respect to $g$ is the unique torsion-free connection determined by
$$X\, g(Y,Z)=g(
abla_X Y, Z)+g(Y,
abla^*_X Z),\qquad X,Y,Z\in \Gamma(TM),$$
and $(M,g,
abla^*)$ is again a statistical manifold.

For a smooth map $\psi:(M,g,
abla)	o(M,g,
abla^*)$, define its tension field $	au(\psi)$ in the usual way, using the Levi-Civita connection on the source side and $
abla^*$ to differentiate the differential of $\psi$ on the target side (so that $	au(\psi)$ depends on the chosen statistical structures). The bienergy of $\psi$ over a relatively compact domain $D\subset M$ is
$$E_2(\psi;D)= rac12\int_D \|	au(\psi)\|_g^2\, dv_g,$$
and $\psi$ is called a critical point of the bienergy if it is a critical point of $E_2(\,\cdot\,;D)$ with respect to all smooth compactly supported variations through smooth maps $(M,g,
abla)	o(M,g,
abla^*)$, for every relatively compact $D\subset M$.

Problem. Characterize the statistical manifolds $(M,g,
abla)$ for which the identity map $\mathrm{id}_M:(M,g,
abla)	o(M,g,
abla^*)$ is a critical point of the bienergy functional.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open problem in information geometry. A related preprint ("Statistical Biharmonicity of Identity Maps", arXiv:2411.14156) studies statistical biharmonicity of identity maps and identifies the tension field with a scalar multiple of the Tchebychev vector field in certain settings, providing partial results, but a full characterization of statistical manifolds whose identity map is a bienergy critical point does not appear to be established.

status_evidence.title: Statistical Biharmonicity of Identity Maps
status_evidence.snippet: In a certain setting, the tension field of the identity map between two statistical manifolds of different statistical structures is a scalar multiple of the Tchebychev vector field. Statistical manifolds have been determined that have the identity map as a biharmonic map.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist for the statistical biharmonicity of identity maps, but a complete characterization remains a research direction.

status_evidence.title: Open problems in information geometry: FDIG 2025
status_evidence.snippet: Open problems in information geometry are collected and discussed in the conference FDIG 2025.
status_evidence.claim: The question is listed among open problems in information geometry.
